topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't stop thinking about what you told me. I mean, I see her, and I’m just... all the pieces don’t fit anymore. It’s like everything we thought, everything we talked about—her days, her stories—they were just... I don’t know, not real. I feel like I don’t even know her, and that’s tearing me up inside. We trusted her, we shared so much, and she was just... building this whole other life? I keep thinking maybe I missed something, some sign. But mostly, I just feel so lost right now. How do we even start to work this out?
